Provider replay fixtures combine public RD/Nordea examples inspected on
2026-09-14 with synthetic edge cases and synthetic Jyske/Totalkredit products.
They cover product variants, excluded products, missing prices, RD corrections,
negative floating rates and zero-rate rejection. They are not a live market snapshot.

expected_products.json was generated by replaying these payloads through the
adapters and validation at commit ecab64c, before the institute pipeline refactor.
Non-finite absent prices are represented as JSON null. The new pure adapters
must produce the same products and numeric values; issues are tested separately.
